title: Effects of Baerveldt Glaucoma Implant Surgery on Corneal Endothelial Cells of Patients with No History of Trabeculectomy

license.statement: Dove Medical Press terms incorporating CC BY-NC 3.0 unported (article <license> and ali:license_ref); not CC BY, so the record is private

indication: POAG, pseudoexfoliation, neovascular and other secondary glaucoma without prior trabeculectomy (refractory; Baerveldt implant)
design: retrospective single-centre study, one eye per patient, follow-up of more than 12 months required

groups.description: Baerveldt glaucoma implant with the tube inserted into the anterior chamber (Table 4 'AC')

groups.indication: glaucoma without prior trabeculectomy (VC group; more neovascular glaucoma)
groups.description: Baerveldt glaucoma implant with the tube inserted into the vitreous cavity with pars plana vitrectomy (Table 4 'VC')

series.notes: mean ± SD (n); n = 23 at the pre-operative and 1-year cells; years 2-5 excluded (censored at additional glaucoma surgery)
mean ± SD (n); n = 62 at the pre-operative and 1-year cells; years 2-5 excluded (censored at additional glaucoma surgery)

exclusions.what: Table 4 IOP at 2, 3, 4 and 5 years for AC and VC (T0004!R5C2-R8C2 and R5C4-R8C4)
exclusions.reason: Methods: for eyes that underwent additional glaucoma surgery only the IOP data before that surgery were used, so means at visits with fewer eyes are censored at additional surgery (outcome-defined, protocol inclusion 4). The 1-year cells still include every eye (n equals the pre-operative n) and are kept.

exclusions.what: Table 4 medication columns and p-value columns
exclusions.reason: medications are not IOP; p-values are not admissible

exclusions.what: Tables 2 and 3 multivariate analyses; Figures 1-3 Kaplan-Meier success
exclusions.reason: model estimates and Kaplan-Meier estimates are not admissible

notes: Tonometer is not stated in the article; method unstated.
Preoperative IOP on glaucoma medication (pre-operative medications tabulated in Tables 1 and 4).

Additional glaucoma surgery was reported in five eyes and tube repositioning from the anterior chamber to the vitreous cavity in four AC eyes; their timing is not reported. The 1-year n equals the pre-operative n in both groups, so no eye had been censored by then.
Medication: mean number of glaucoma medications per visit is tabulated in Table 4; not extracted.
The abstract gives the VC group as n=63 while Tables 1 and 4 give 62 eyes; the table counts are used.
Group roles: anterior-chamber and vitreous-cavity tube placement are two standard techniques chosen by the surgeons, no experimental arm; both role control.
